From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Subject: Evidence provenance attestation — Vendr portal manifest

Elena —

Thanks again for the quick onboarding of our profile this quarter. As part of our SOC 2 / CAIQ evidence collection we need explicit provenance for the evidence you uploaded to Vendr. Can you provide a short attestation that the manifest you uploaded (and the S3 locations referenced) reflect records in your custody and include signed hashes or KMS key references that we can verify?

Specifically we need:
- A signed manifest (SHA256 hashes) for the evidence objects you linked to the Vendr profile.
- The KMS key ID used to encrypt any archived evidence and an attestation of key ownership/rotation cadence.
- A statement of the retention policy/ttl for the artifacts and any ephemeral log extracts included in the bundle.
- A machine-readable CAIQ-to-evidence mapping (spreadsheet or Drive link) so we can tie SIG answers to concrete artifacts.

I'm attaching a short template (evidence-request-template.docx) to make this easier; a one-page attestation signed by your security lead is fine. Ideal timeline would be EOD Wednesday (2026-12-22) so we can include it in an incoming SIG review for a prospective customer (Acme). If you have a DocuSign flow, that also works.

Thanks — we appreciate the help.

Naomi Feldman
Security Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[attachment: evidence-request-template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Attaching the manifest (vendr-manifest.json) that enumerates the objects we uploaded to our profile for Redwood; each entry includes an S3 path, a SHA256 hash, and a kms_key_id where applicable. We can provide a signed PDF attestation from our Head of Security and roll that into DocuSign — I've initiated that and will share the link in a follow-up.

A couple quick clarifications:
1) For archived logs we include GUIDs rather than raw PII; if you need redacted copies or narrower extracts for the CAIQ mapping let us know.
2) Our KMS rotation is quarterly — I will include the last three rotation timestamps in the attestation.
3) We have a CAIQ mapping spreadsheet but it's a working doc; I'll snapshot it as a view-only Drive link.

I'll follow up with the attestation and the DocuSign link by EOD Monday.

Best,
Elena Park
Sr. Information Security Manager, Vendr
